items.description:
Rix Pawnshop is a family-owned pawnbroker on Witklip Street in Annadale, Polokwane, operating since 2015 and centrally located in the city. It buys, sells and pawns pre-owned and new goods, including pool table equipment, catering equipment, furniture, electronics and tools.

The shop says it buys almost anything and pays cash for goods. Customers can send a photo through WhatsApp for an offer, or ask the team to visit within Polokwane at no charge, and the shop also lends cash against goods. It describes its transactions as professional, friendly, discreet and confidential, and it is licensed under the Second-Hand Goods Act and is a registered member of the National Credit Regulator.

Rochester Savannah Mall is the Savannah Mall branch of the Rochester furniture chain, trading from the lower level of the centre in Fauna Park. The store specialises in household furniture and home furnishings, giving shoppers in and around Polokwane a dedicated furniture outlet inside one of the city's main shopping centres rather than a general homeware aisle.

Confirmed directly through Rochester's own store locator, the branch trades from Shop G12-G16 near Entrance 3 of Savannah Mall on Grimm Street, Fauna Park. It opens Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 09:00 to 16:00 and Sundays from 09:00 to 14:00, making it a convenient stop for households furnishing a home or replacing furniture nearby.

SA Compressor Care sells, installs and services air compressors of all major brands, with its services covering repairs, 24-hour standby support, field services and the installation of pneumatic pipelines. The company also offers on-site pressure testing, the repair and supply of rockdrills and paving breakers, and the repair of high-pressure mobile and piston compressors.

Its list of services includes the repair and servicing of refrigerant and desiccant dryers, and the business gives technical advice on all aspects of compressed air. Its compressor hire fleet has a wide range of mobile and electrical rental units available. The company's website lists sales, repairs and services on Kaeser products, and it is based in Polokwane.

Skipper Bar's branch in Limpopo Mall is a casual clothing and footwear outlet, confirmed directly through the chain's own store locator as a current trading branch in Polokwane. The store stocks casual wear and footwear, giving shoppers in Polokwane Central a dedicated outlet for everyday clothing and shoes rather than a general fashion department.

The branch trades from Shop 24A in Limpopo Mall, on the corner of Rissik and Market Street in Polokwane Central. Its position inside one of the city centre's established shopping destinations makes it a convenient stop for shoppers looking to update their casual wardrobe or footwear while running other errands in town.

The Cottage is a self-catering guest accommodation set among simply furnished cottages with a garden, offering short-stay guests a quiet, home-like base rather than a conventional hotel room. Current booking information for the property confirms complimentary Wi-Fi, free on-site parking and air conditioning, useful anchor amenities for travellers comparing self-catering options in Polokwane.

The property is at 78 Erasmus Street in Flora Park, with check-in from 15:00 and check-out by 10:00. It suits business travellers, holidaymakers and anyone wanting a self-catering stay with garden surroundings rather than a standard hotel room, within easy reach of Polokwane's amenities, and the fixed check-in and check-out times give guests a clear routine for arrival and departure.

The Red Bin is a rubble and waste removal service in Ladine, Polokwane, offering residential, commercial, industrial and construction rubble and waste removal in and around Polokwane, Tzaneen and Louis Trichardt. It is a division of the BF Petroleum Group, and its service runs from receiving an order through to disposing of the waste in a responsible manner.

Customers can order a skip, and the company says it tailors its solutions to each client's needs. Its website describes a simple booking process, with clients calling the business and the team collecting the waste. The company is based at 124 Blaauwberg Street in Ladine, Polokwane.

Tiger Wheel & Tyre The Crossing is a branch of the national tyre and wheel specialist chain, listed as an authorised dealer on Michelin's own dealer locator under its Polokwane-area listing. The branch supplies and fits tyres and wheel-related products, serving motorists who need new tyres, wheel alignment or related fitment work on their vehicles.

The store trades from The Crossing shopping centre, on the corner of Grobler and Grimm Street in Fauna Park, Polokwane. Being listed through a major tyre manufacturer's own dealer network gives local motorists an added point of reference when choosing where to have tyres fitted or wheels serviced in the Fauna Park area.

Timberland's store in Mall of the North stocks the American brand's outdoor-focused footwear and apparel, confirmed as a current tenant through the mall's own store directory. Shoppers can find Timberland's boots, shoes and outdoor clothing lines at this Bendor outlet, catering to customers looking for durable, outdoor-ready footwear and apparel rather than everyday fashion basics.

The store trades from Shop U55 in Mall of the North on Munnik Avenue, Bendor. Its place among the mall's wider shoe and fashion offering makes it a straightforward stop for shoppers in Polokwane wanting Timberland's footwear and clothing without ordering online or travelling further afield.

items.reason: Location and branch confirmed via Tiendeo and Shopshours trading-hours listings for Madiba Park Shopping Centre, but the current liquor product range and in-store services for this specific Tops at Spar branch could not be independently confirmed from the available sources. Held pending a source that describes this branch's own offering rather than chain/aggregator listing data.

items.description:
Toys R Us trades from Mall of the North under the brand's combined Toys R Us and Babies R Us retail format, confirmed through the brand's own official store page for this branch. The store stocks toys, games and children's products, serving children, parents and families shopping for everything from everyday toys to baby and infant goods.

The store is at Shop U68 in Mall of the North, on the corner of the N1 Bypass and Modjadjiskloof Road in Bendor. It opens from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and from 09:00 to 17:00 on weekends and public holidays, giving families flexible time to browse toys and children's essentials in one visit.

items.reason: The United Furniture Outlets (UFO) retail format and group ownership (Lewis Group) is confirmed nationally, but no source captures this specific Game Centre branch's current product range, trading hours or branch-specific detail -- the Lewis Group brand page and a Brabys listing give chain-level information only. Held pending a source describing this branch directly.

items.description:
USave Seshego is a discount grocery store serving the local Seshego community with everyday groceries, fresh produce and household essentials at low prices, run in the no-frills small-format style typical of the USave brand. Current mapping information for the store confirms its trading address, contact number and that it opens every day of the week, making it a dependable, low-cost grocery option for households topping up basic supplies between bigger shops.

The store is at 52 Kwena Street, Moloto, Polokwane, and opens Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 and on Saturdays and Sundays from 08:00 to 17:00. It suits shoppers looking for a nearby, budget-focused grocery stop rather than a full supermarket trip across town.

Adendorff Machinery Mart is a tools and machinery retailer offering hardware, machinery and related equipment for workshops, trade use and DIY projects. Confirmed as a current branch through Adendorff's own official store locator, the outlet gives DIY users, tradespeople, workshops and contractors in the Polokwane area a dedicated source for tools and machinery rather than general hardware stock alone.

The branch trades in Polokwane and is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00, closed on Sundays. Its position within the national Adendorff network gives contractors and DIY customers access to the chain's wider tools and machinery range through a local branch.

AVBOB Funeral Service Mankweng is a branch of the national AVBOB funeral group, confirmed through the branch's own listing as a trading location in Paledi Mall. The branch assists bereaved families and individuals with arranging funeral services, guiding them through burial and cremation decisions and the practical steps of putting a funeral together, supported by trained AVBOB staff.

The branch is at Shop 15 in Paledi Mall on the R71 at Ga Thoka, Mankweng. It gives families in and around Mankweng a local point of contact for funeral arrangements, rather than having to travel into Polokwane itself when a death needs to be dealt with close to home.

Beauty Matters is a medical aesthetics clinic and spa in Eduan Park, Polokwane, dedicated to women's beauty and wellbeing. It offers medical anti-ageing treatments, including laser hair removal, facial rejuvenation and skin resurfacing, alongside micro-needling, chemical peels and dermaplaning.

The clinic also offers a full range of body treatments, manicures, pedicures and signature treatments, and it sells a Lamelle skincare range that clients can use at home. Clients on its website praise the clinic's professionalism, cleanliness and punctuality, and they describe the staff as friendly and knowledgeable. Clients can reserve a treatment through the website's Make a Booking button. The clinic is at 214 Potgieter Avenue in Eduan Park.

Bosman Attorneys is a law firm in Hospital Park, Polokwane, founded in 2003 and built on more than 20 years of practice. The firm handles civil and criminal litigation, family law, legal costs and bail applications, and its practice areas include estate planning.

The firm says it places each client's needs first and delivers a valued, personal service with traditional values and integrity, all within the framework of the law. Its team of seasoned professionals invites visitors to request a consultation through the website. The firm says its senior legal practitioner holds right of appearance in the High Court and has more than 20 years of experience in civil and criminal litigation. The office is at 37 Voortrekker Street in Hospital Park, Polokwane.

Boss Recruitment is a provisional placement and training agency in IT Park, Bendor, established in Polokwane in 1995. The agency says it has a track record of more than 15 years in recruitment and works with small and medium enterprises, corporate clients and government.

Its services include executive and general placements, temporary and contract placements, HR outsourcing and consulting, and training. Employment screening covers pre-employment checks, reference checks, and ITC, criminal, educational and driver's licence checks. The agency says its core values are integrity, service excellence, professionalism and flexible staffing solutions. Clients can advertise vacancies at no cost, and the agency handles the responses to those adverts. Its office is at 11 Pierre Street.

BUCO Polokwane is a branch of the BUCO hardware and building-materials chain, confirmed as an official store location through the retailer's own store locator. The branch stocks hardware and building supplies along with an on-site garden centre, giving DIY customers, homeowners, builders and contractors in Superbia a single stop for both building materials and gardening supplies.

The store trades from 18 Sapphire Street in Superbia, serving Superbia and the surrounding parts of Polokwane. Having a garden centre alongside the usual hardware and building range makes it a useful stop for customers tackling anything from a small home repair to a full landscaping or building project.

items.reason: The listed address, 18 Sapphire Street, Superbia, is independently confirmed by BUCO's own official store locator as the address of BUCO Polokwane-Sapphire (see the separate BUCO Polokwane listing in this chunk), raising an unresolved duplicate or business-name conflict at the same address. Held rather than published, merged or closed, pending clarification of whether this is a distinct trading business or a stale/duplicate listing for the BUCO branch.

items.description:
Builders Warehouse Polokwane is a branch of the national Builders Warehouse chain, offering building, DIY and home-improvement products and solutions to shoppers in and around Nirvana. The branch's confirmed store listing sets out its trading hours and location, supporting homeowners, DIY customers and builders working through construction or home-improvement projects of various sizes.

The store is at 139 Crescent Drive in Nirvana, Polokwane, and opens Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 07:00 to 16:00 and Sundays from 08:00 to 14:00. Its long opening hours, including Sunday trading, make it a practical stop for customers fitting a building or renovation project around a weekend schedule.

Cardies at Mall of the North is a branch of the South African greeting cards, gifts and stationery retailer, confirmed as a current store through the chain's own official store listing. The branch stocks greeting cards, gift items and stationery products, giving shoppers in Bendor a dedicated stop for cards and small gifts rather than relying on a general retailer's limited range.

The store trades from Mall of the North on Munnik Avenue, Bendor. It suits shoppers picking up a card and gift for a birthday, celebration or special occasion, or stocking up on everyday stationery items while out at the mall.

Held until the address conflict between the batch listing and the municipal guide is settled.

A Cylex directory listing gives address, phone and generic opening hours for this gym, but the gym's own current website and social channels were not available to confirm its CrossFit affiliation, specific class structure (30- and 60-minute sessions, an extra Saturday class) or that it still trades at 115 Diemeer Street. Held pending the gym's own current confirmation of these details.

items.description:
CTM Polokwane is a branch of CTM, South Africa's largest tile and bathroom retailer, stocking tiles, bathroom products and related home-improvement products for the local market. A current business-directory listing for the branch confirms its trading address and contact details, serving homeowners, renovators, builders and contractors working on bathroom or flooring projects around Polokwane.

The store trades from 26 Mangaan Street in Superbia, within Polokwane's established hardware and building-supplies area. It gives customers in the area a dedicated tile and bathroom specialist to turn to when planning a renovation, rather than relying on a general hardware store's smaller tile and sanitaryware range, as part of a long-standing national retail network with stores across the country.

Daniel Hechter's store in Mall of the North is a fashion retail outlet confirmed as a current Mall of the North tenant via the mall's own store directory. The shop offers Daniel Hechter's menswear-led fashion range, serving customers in Bendor who are shopping specifically for the brand's clothing rather than a general fashion department.

The store trades from Shop U12c in Mall of the North, Bendor, and keeps the same hours as the wider mall: 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 17:00 on weekends and public holidays. It gives shoppers a dedicated branded option for Daniel Hechter pieces without travelling beyond Polokwane.

items.reason: A near-place directory listing confirms the guesthouse's address and phone number, but shows a placeholder 'open 24 hours' schedule, and the only other material found was a set of mostly critical customer reviews about room and bathroom condition. Room facilities and current services (air-conditioning, pool, bar, conference facility) are not confirmed by a reliable business-specific source, so the listing is held rather than published from reviews alone.

items.description:
ERA Real Estate Polokwane is a residential estate agency operating as part of the national ERA network, handling property sales and rental listings for buyers, sellers, landlords and prospective tenants in and around the city. Current mapping information for the office confirms its trading address and contact details as an active branch in Polokwane Central.

The office is at 8 Landdros Mare Street, Polokwane Central, and keeps weekday hours from 08:00 to 16:00. It gives clients a local point of contact for buying, selling or renting residential property, backed by the wider ERA brand's reach beyond the immediate Polokwane market.

Held pending a source that clears up the conflicting hours and confirms the current practitioner mix.

items.description:
Florapark Comprehensive Primary School is a public primary school in Flora Park, established in 1998 and classified as a Quintile 5 school. It has around 1,346 learners and a staff of 39 teachers, and it sits on the corner of Jasmyn Avenue and Van Marle Street.

The school's website includes a digital library split into bands for Grades 1 to 3, 4 to 5 and 6 to 7, along with past ANA papers and memos. Families can download the school's mobile app, and the school shares a gallery of its school photos and videos. The school's team credits its educators for the hard work they put in every day.

G-Star RAW's store in Mall of the North is confirmed as a current branch through the brand's own official store page, which also notes that online orders placed with G-Star can be collected in person at this store. The branch stocks the brand's denim-focused fashion and apparel, serving customers specifically shopping for G-Star RAW jeans and clothing rather than denim as part of a wider fashion range.

The store trades inside Mall of the North, at the corner of the R81 and N1 Bypass in Bendor Ext 99. The option to collect online orders in-store gives shoppers added flexibility, whether they are buying in person or picking up an order placed from home.

Gae Country Lodge is a lodge and conference centre on Kalkfontein Farm off the R71 near Dalmada, listed under that lodge-and-conference-centre format in current business-directory listings for the property. Alongside overnight accommodation, the property also operates restaurant and liquor-licensed premises, giving guests a place to eat and drink on site rather than having to travel back into Polokwane.

The lodge is at Kalkfontein Farm 1001 LS, Dalmada, and combines guest accommodation with conference facilities for events, meetings and functions. It suits overnight guests, restaurant patrons and groups booking the property for a conference or function in a rural setting outside central Polokwane.

Galito's Lebowakgomo Mall@Lebo is a flame-grilled and peri-peri chicken restaurant and takeaway, confirmed through the brand's own local page for this branch. The menu covers flame-grilled chicken, chips and side dishes, with both takeaway counter service and online ordering available for customers who would rather collect a meal than sit in.

The restaurant is at Shop 3 in Mall@Lebo on the R579 in Lebowakgomo, opening from 09:00 each day. It serves individual diners, families and takeaway customers looking for a quick peri-peri chicken meal while out at the mall, without needing to travel into central Polokwane for the same brand.

Held pending a source describing this branch's own offering.

items.description:
Hillary Construction is a civil engineering and construction company specialising in roads, earthworks and steel-reinforced concrete structures, alongside the manufacture and supply of its own surfacing products and emulsions. Official company information for the business confirms a CIDB grading of 9CE and 9SB, ISO 9001:2015 certification and BBBEE Level 1 status, positioning it as an established contractor for larger infrastructure work rather than small domestic jobs.

The company is based at 9 Yster Street in Ladanna, Polokwane, and serves government bodies, infrastructure projects and other civil-engineering and construction clients. Its combination of a high CIDB grading and its own surfacing-product manufacturing sets it apart from smaller general building contractors in the area.

House of Asante Spa is a boutique day spa at 29 Jorissen Street in Polokwane Central. It offers full body massages, aromatherapy and hot stone therapy, along with beauty treatments such as manicures, pedicures, waxing, body exfoliation and facials, and the spa says it caters for people who care about looking and feeling good.

The spa's menu includes a traditional hammam bathing ritual and water therapies, and every visit begins with a welcome ritual. Guests can rate their treatment and give feedback afterwards. The spa has a state-of-the-art swimming pool that is free to use after a one-hour spa treatment, and bookings can be made by phone or through the online booking form on its website.

IT Experts is an IT support company in Bendor, Polokwane, that has supported homes and businesses across Polokwane and Limpopo since 2007. Its services include computer repairs, desktop, server and network support, server management, and sales of IT hardware and software, with a focus on corporate clients.

The company also offers VoIP telephony with a fixed monthly call cost, cloud desktops, and a range of internet connectivity from LTE, wireless and fibre that can be customised to each client's needs. Its office-in-the-cloud service gives staff secure remote access. The company is based at Ismini Office Estate on Adjutant Mauritz Dommisie Street in Bendor.

Lapologa at Polokwane is a guesthouse in the quiet, busy Flora Park suburb, offering self-catering apartments that are stylish, tastefully decorated and open-plan. The apartments have ample space for a business traveller or a whole family, and each has a fully equipped kitchenette, air-conditioning and DStv.

The establishment is a four-star graded guesthouse and describes itself as a luxury and comfort-driven stay, centrally located for business or holiday travel. Polokwane is close to the Kruger National Park and the Magoebaskloof mountains, and the guesthouse is a convenient base for visitors travelling to neighbouring countries. The guesthouse is at 362 Suid Street in Flora Park.

Neither confirms whether the business still trades, at this address, with these services, years on. Held pending confirmation of its current trading status.

items.description:
Limpo Security is a private security company based at the Seshego Industrial Site, which describes itself as passionate about reducing crime in Limpopo and South Africa. It offers guarding, patrolling, access control, monitoring and CCTV surveillance, alarm systems, gate automation and VIP protection across the Capricorn District.

The company says it structures its security services around each client's specific needs, whether for a business or a private home. Its website sets out the services on a dedicated page, and visitors are invited to contact the team to find out how the company can help. The company is at Factory No. 05C/12 on Freedom Drive in Seshego.

Limpopo Seamless Gutters manufactures colour-coated seamless gutters, box gutters, fascia boards and roof sheeting on site, matched to each roof, in Polokwane Central. The company also supplies aluminium, Chromadeck and zinc-alume gutters, and it installs them for homeowners, contractors and property managers.

Its services include roof and house painting, roof flashing, barge and fascia boards, and torch-on waterproofing, along with roof, wall and balcony waterproofing. The company works on new developments, schools, hospitals and office projects, and it supplies a range of colours that includes silver, white, charcoal and Colonial green. Customers can send an inquiry through the website, and the business is at 117 Thabo Mbeki Street.

The Local Choice Pharmacy on Market Street is a pharmacy offering dispensing services through an on-site dispensary, along with an in-store clinic and a click-and-collect option for customers who would rather order ahead than wait in-store. Current store information for this Market Street location confirms these services, serving customers who need prescription medicines, over-the-counter healthcare products or basic clinic services.

The pharmacy trades in Polokwane Central on Market Street, giving shoppers in the city centre a healthcare stop that combines a dispensary, clinic and collection service in one place. It suits anyone filling a prescription, consulting the in-store clinic for a minor health concern, or collecting an order placed in advance.

MarTek Roofing is a MiTek-licensed truss fabricator in Magna Via, Polokwane, established in 1991, which designs, manufactures and installs timber and galvanised steel roof trusses. The company describes its work as quality services with expert roof design, manufacturing and installation backed by certified engineering.

The team uses the latest MiTek software to design cost-effective roof frames, and it handles installation for both domestic and industrial projects. Its published process runs from a detailed quote and discussion through payment, measuring and planning to manufacture, installation and sign-off. The company says its main factory in Magna Via has operated since 2010, and it is at 30 Kaye-Lyn Street.

items.description:
Reconnect Day Spa is a family spa on McDonald Avenue in Fauna Park, Polokwane, with a Pretoria branch as well. Its treatments include body massages, facials, body scrubs and wraps, an infrared sauna, hot stone and deep tissue massages, and special treatments for guests.

The spa offers customised packages for birthdays, anniversaries and family celebrations, along with kiddies spa and mom-and-daughter packages. The business says it has been operating since 2010 and describes its staff as friendly, professional and passionate about making every customer feel special. The Polokwane branch is at 94 McDonald Avenue in Fauna Park, behind Savannah Mall.

items.description:
S² Electrical is an electrical contractor in Welgelegen, Polokwane, handling domestic to industrial installations and electrical contracting. In addition to general electrical work, the company can carry out large contracts with electrical consultants, and it is certified to design and install solar power systems.

The business says it is an authorised company, registered with the relevant authorities, and that it takes pride in quality workmanship and service excellence. Its website also highlights fast delivery and 24/7 customer service, and its mission statement commits the team to productive, proactive and accountable work without compromising safety and reliability. The company is at 135 General Kritzinger Street.
